Girl of the Night Garden.

Animated film · 2026

A nocturnal dream. 1980s manga, faded television and dark nostalgia.

I directed the film around Cristian Grossi’s illustrations and a screenplay by Matteo Martignoni. Kreativehouse produced it.

The soundtrack uses an excerpt from “Techno 80 - base loop” by frankum, licensed under CC BY 4.0.
